ownership_summary: Majority-owned and controlled by Fenway Sports Group (John Henry, Tom Werner), which bought the club in 2010 for £300m. Dynasty Equity bought about 3% in September 2023. In August 2026 FSG agreed to sell about 30% to 1892 Holdings, a consortium led by Amit Bhatia with the Mittal Family Trusts, K5 Sports (Jeff Bezos lead investor) and EE Capital (Saverin family office), at a reported valuation of just over $7bn; closing is subject to regulatory approval and FSG keeps majority ownership and control. RedBird Capital holds 11.5% of FSG itself (2021), not of the club directly.
